limitations: Owner modules must provide immutable scope values, scope matching, approval/eligibility evaluation and their approved precedence cohort.
This primitive identifies version metadata; policy payload ownership, financial calculations, persistence and authorization are outside this work item.
Role reviews are Codex engineering reviews, not independent human or Product acceptance.
acceptance_results: Exact historical version selection uses explicit business time and owner scope.
Missing and ambiguous resolution exposes no selected version; no fallback or latest-version tie breaker exists.
Duplicate IDs, malformed intervals and missing or failing owner callbacks are rejected.
Owner interval inclusion, status meaning, approval and precedence stay explicit; immutable metadata and copied evidence are retained.
No financial calculation, Product policy values, public API, persistence, provider or UI behavior was introduced.
